senses.gloss:
गगनं(णं) (Some suppose गगण to
be an incorrect form, as is observed
by a writer:
--फाल्गुने गगने फेने
णत्वमिच्छंति बर्बराः)
1 The sky, atmosphere;
अवोचदेनं गगनस्पृशा रघुः स्वरेण R. 3. 43;
गगनमिव नष्टतारं Pt. 5. 6; सोयं चद्रंः
पतति गगनात् Ś. 4. v. l.; Śi. 9. 27.
--2 (In math.) A cypher.
--3
Firmament.
--4 Heaven.
--Comp.
--अग्रं
the highest heavens.
--अंगना a
heavenly nymph, an Apsaras.
--अध्वगः {1} the sun. {2} a planet. {3} a
celestial being.
--अंबु n. rain-water.
--उल्मुकः the planet Mars.
--कुसुमंपुष्पं ‘sky-flower’; i. e. any unreal
thing, an impossibility; see खपुष्प.
--गतिः {1} a deity. {2} a celestial
being; Me. 46. {3} a planet.
--चर
(also गगनेचर) a. moving in the air.
--(रः) {1} a bird. {2} a planet. {3}
a heavenly spirit. {4} a lunar
mansion. {5} the zodiac (राशिचक्र).
--ध्वजः {1} the sun. {2} a cloud.
--विहारिन् a. moving or ranging in the sky;
H. 1. 21. (--m.) {1} a luminary. {2}
the sun. {3} a celestial being.
--सद्
a. dwelling in the air. (--m.) a
celestial being; Śi. 4. 53.
--सिंधुः f.
an epithet of the Ganges.
--स्थ, --स्थित
a. situated in the sky.
--स्पर्शनः {1} air,
wind. {2} N. of one of the eight
Maruts.
